<thought>To find the precursors, I first need the retrosynthetic template that matches the described forward reaction (intramolecular Michael addition forming a flavanone). I will search the template catalog using the functional groups broken/formed and bonds formed/broken. I will assume the target molecule is a typical flavanone with SMILES "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12".</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
